result.rationale: These proof excerpts use the same A at t=0 and t=T to derive the key inequality without justifying why A should remain fixed/identical across the flow, exposing the annotated gap.

Annotation flags unjustified assumption that A(0)=A(T); system instead argues the asymptotic/order-of-magnitude mismatch in deriving the inequality from tightness of (2.4). Different mathematical issues, not the same defect.
